# Model transforms

Ghost features: profiles that walk the assembled module tree and rewrite matched parameters in place, storing 1/d of a weight and deriving the rest by a fixed signed permutation. Each profile is a target regex plus an algebra. Selected with ``--transform-type``; default is ``none``.

Registry: ``praxis.TRANSFORM_REGISTRY`` (10 entries)

## `ghost_all_auto`

Value: `TransformProfile(spec=TargetSpec(include=('.*',), exclude=(), max_param_numel=None), algebra='auto', randomize=False, skip_vocab=True, request_alignment=True)`

## `ghost_all_complex`

Value: `TransformProfile(spec=TargetSpec(include=('.*',), exclude=(), max_param_numel=None), algebra='complex', randomize=False, skip_vocab=True, request_alignment=True)`
